sn_aia_tool.description: This tool can be used to retrieve the upgrade history record based on the user selection. It takes the sys ID of the upgrade record <upgradeID> as the input.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"upgradeID","description":"This is the selected upgrade history record that needs to be analysed.","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Retrieve Upgrade History Record Details
